tools.name: aurora_tonight
tools.description: Can I see the northern lights (or southern lights) tonight from a place? Hour by hour through the dark hours: NOAA's predicted Kp index, whether the auroral oval reaches overhead or the horizon there, cloud cover, and a good/possible/unlikely verdict with the best window. Up to 3 nights.

tools.name: aurora_now
tools.description: Is the aurora visible right now from a place? NOAA's OVATION nowcast probability overhead and on the poleward horizon (next 30 to 90 minutes), the current Kp index, whether it is dark and the current cloud cover.

tools.name: kp_forecast
tools.description: NOAA's planetary Kp index forecast for the next three days in 3-hour UTC blocks, with the NOAA G-scale storm level, plus the last 24 hours observed and the daily maximum. Kp 5 or more is a geomagnetic storm and pushes aurora toward mid latitudes.

tools.name: space_weather_alerts
tools.description: Recent NOAA SWPC space weather alerts, watches and warnings: geomagnetic storm watches (aurora outlook), Kp warnings, solar radiation and radio blackout alerts, newest first.

tools.name: aurora_compare_locations
tools.description: Rank 2 to 10 places by tonight's aurora chances: good and possible dark hours, cloud, and the Kp needed, so you can choose where to drive.
